meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 它先拉取 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码、跑最小复现确认根因，再把 bug 写成一份英文 GitHub issue，含环境、复现步骤、根因、修复建议和验证计划，并加 lazycodex-generated 标签；只有 openai/codex 才可能提 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求上报、登记或分诊 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 安装器崩溃报个 issue
say.note: 它会先复现并定位归属仓库

say.text: 上游 Codex CLI 沙箱行为异常，帮我查根因并提 PR
say.note: 只有 openai/codex 才会建 PR

say.text: 这个报错先搜下有没有现成 issue，有就补证据
say.note: 有匹配项时改为在该 issue 下评论

howto.what_en: It pulls the LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources, runs a minimal reproduction to confirm the root cause, then files an English GitHub issue with environment, steps, root cause, fix guidance and verification; PRs only for openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to report, file or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex installer crash bug for me.
say_en.note: It reproduces and picks the owning repo
